rationale: Native BCAPAdam failed both scores and was deactivated. The half-network-step pure model has better donorES but worse cellED than the selected PG8/learned ensemble. Test one equal-weight whole-bag mixture of these two different optimizer/observation forecasts for complementary distribution residuals. This changes component set relative to the rejected uniformtrainingseed mixture and does not rank training seeds or scan weights/masks.
allowed_inputs: Existing generated seed0 arrays and their independently verified scalar/checkpoint proofs only; no new target/evaluation arrays, generation, fitting, GPU allocation or quality repair.
decision: One analytic fixed100-of200 outer-mask expectation and equal-weight empiricalcellmixture. Strictly lower ES and no greater pooled cellED than current selected pure incumbent. A positive screen needs actual fixed-mask/commonquery/RNG/count/spread/native-source verification before any candidate selection.
compute: Three underlying pure20k count models: total60000 parent updates vs selected40000. Mixture is whole bags, never within-cell/count blending and never empiricalresampling.
limitations: Analytical expectation is not the exact native outer mask, empiricalcellreservoir mixture is not a newly sampled native reservoir, and nested generation can alter global Gamma RNG. This is adaptive calibration exploration. The previously failed originalthree-seed result remains failed and fully retained; no retrospective repair or reclassification.
